title: Daily Digest A: Injury Watch (Tue Nov 17)
parts:
🩹 DEVYDOSE INJURY WATCH | Week 12

Week 12 injury news: a Big Ten QB had surgery, an Oregon sophomore RB is out of his boot, and Alabama's 5⭐ QB played through an ankle injury 🧵👇

🔶 ILLINOIS

🩹 Katin Houser | QB | SR | #37 QB: had surgery on a broken nose, and Illinois is preparing SO Carson Boyd for Iowa (via On3)

It's his second surgery this fall. He came back 19 days after hand surgery earlier this season (via 247Sports).

🦆 OREGON

🩹 Jordon Davison | RB | SO, 4⭐ | #27 RB: out of his walking boot ahead of Michigan State (via On3)

He missed Ohio State and Michigan with a leg injury (via 247Sports, Fantrax).

✅ Keelon Russell | QB | Alabama | SO, 5⭐ | #8 QB: started at Vanderbilt despite the ankle and threw 3 TDs (via On3, Fantrax)

Also: Joey McGuire addressed Texas Tech QB Thomas Castellanos' (#50 QB) health before Baylor (via On3).

Whose status are you watching? 👇
